rubric_scores.evidence_quote: Most teams we talk to struggle with dispatch, so let me show you how we fix that.
rubric_scores.why: The rep asked no questions about problems before pitching.

rubric_scores.why: The rep asked who decides but not the steps or timeline.

rubric_scores.evidence_quote: Right, right, so that's exactly what our dispatch module handles.
rubric_scores.why: The rep cut in and answered a question the prospect had not asked.
